name: Master Oogrish
size: About 5 feet tall, most of it shell
appearance: An old, broad-shelled turtle with a mossy green shell, a long white mustache, and calm amber eyes. He wears a weathered general's sash and a woven reed cloak over his shell and leans on the Staff of Wisdom. A golden clockwork medallion hangs at his neck.
personality: Patient, wise, and a little stubborn. He has led soldiers before and likes to think two moves ahead.
weakness: His shell makes him slow to turn and slower to climb, and he trusts old friends too easily, a lesson his rival taught him the hard way.

weapon.name: Staff of Wisdom
weapon.verb: strikes with the Staff of Wisdom

inventory.name: Staff of Wisdom
inventory.note: An old temple staff. It is also a relic, and its full power is still a mystery.

inventory.name: Clockwork medallion
inventory.note: Golden, full of ticking cogs, with a glowing blue sphere inside. It hums when something strange is coming.

backstory: Long ago, Oogrish fought side by side with his friend Varkos. Varkos grew greedy for power, and Oogrish had to stand against him. After defeating Varkos, Oogrish became a wise weapons master at the Peace Temple who taught others to protect the weak.
pastLife: Back home he carried a rapid-fire combat shotgun and a heavy six-shot revolver. Neither crossed over with him. Firearms in this world are steampunk machines that run on runes and magic.
